dedupe_keys.name: mvbep building energy measurement and verification

description: MVBEP is a Python package maintained by the Robaie98 project for building baseline energy models and estimating retrofit savings. It fits regression models to historical pre-retrofit consumption, predicts the counterfactual baseline in the post-retrofit period and compares it with measured consumption. Its modules cover data preparation, model development, interpretation and savings quantification, with static HTML reports for the main stages. Coverage and temporal resolution depend on the user's building records; the software contains no fixed geographic stock or universal monitoring period. Public source, PyPI installation and a demonstration notebook are free under MIT. The README identifies unfinished module documentation, manually performed testing and a proposed combined goodness-of-fit metric that is not yet implemented. These limitations matter when checking a baseline or reproducing reported savings. The package can support calibration and evaluation of building-energy intervention scenarios, complementing physical models such as EnergyPlus (model-energyplus). Its cited 2022 review explains the data-driven measurement-and-verification context, not establishing validation of every package function. No building consumption records were downloaded.
